ranking.page_title: Editorial Standards Ranking — Editorial Standards Platform
ranking.page_description: Ranking of scientific journals with an active Editorial Standards Seal, ordered by h-index from real citation data (OpenAlex).
ranking.live_badge: Live · ranked by h-index, gated by editorial compliance
ranking.subtitle: Journals with an active Editorial Standards Seal, ordered by h-index. The seal is the entry gate; the order is driven by real citation impact.
ranking.methodology_note_body: Ordered by h-index. The Editorial Standards Seal (active seal, ≥75% + 5 critical indicators) is the entry gate. Primary source: OpenAlex. Manual Scholar snapshots take precedence within 90 days. Monthly refresh.
ranking.empty_title: No journals with resolved metrics yet
ranking.empty_body: The first metrics refresh runs on the 1st of next month. Meanwhile, certified journals are listed in the directory.
ranking.cta_section_title: Want to appear in the ranking?
ranking.cta_section_body: Register your journal, earn the seal, and let your real metrics do the rest.
methodology.ranking_title: How the public ranking is computed
methodology.ranking_intro: The /ranking page orders by real academic impact, not by the compliance score. The seal is the entry gate only.
methodology.ranking_gate_body: To enter the ranking, a journal must hold an active seal: ≥75% compliance + all 5 critical indicators met. Journals without an active seal remain in the /search directory but do not appear in the ranking.
methodology.ranking_order_body: Within the gated group, journals are sorted by h-index — the most robust and comparable impact metric. Tiebreaker is total citations.
methodology.ranking_source_openalex: primary source, free public open API. Resolves by ISSN.
methodology.ranking_source_crossref: contrast count of registered DOIs. Does not feed the ranking, kept for audit.
methodology.ranking_source_scholar: manual capture by an evaluator or admin from Google Scholar Metrics. Useful for LATAM-leaning journals where Scholar coverage is broader than OpenAlex.
methodology.ranking_source_orcid: editorial team members (editor-in-chief, associates, board) declare their ORCID. Does not feed the ranking; shown in the journal profile as a transparency signal.
methodology.ranking_rule_scholar: If a manual Scholar snapshot is younger than 90 days → its h-index takes precedence.
methodology.ranking_rule_openalex: Otherwise, the h-index from OpenAlex is used.
methodology.ranking_rule_missing: If OpenAlex cannot find the journal (ISSN not indexed), the journal does not appear in the ranking. It stays in the /search directory with its seal.
methodology.ranking_rule_crossref: Crossref never feeds the official column — kept for audit and to surface discrepancies to admin.
methodology.ranking_refresh_body: Metrics refresh automatically on the 1st of every month at 03:15 UTC. Admins can also trigger a manual refresh from the panel.
